items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: If you hadn't been tied up with Graham, you would have made that $5,000 right off on it.

ctx.x: So, um...so when Uncle Doc offers $5,000 to dance on it, it wouldn't give Bennett Davis nothing.

Yeah. If you hadn't been tied up with Graham, you would have made that $5,000 right off on it. I sure have. Well, do you want to stop and put those things in the refrigerator? Yeah, might as well. We were talking about the livery stable blues. Were there any other pieces you had published now, much, that you can remember some of those at Abe Lyman? Bees Knees.

What's the name? Bees Knees. Bees Knees. Yeah. That was published. That was published by Fice. Oh, yeah. So, they still say that there's a...at least I got something out of the thing and there might be some more money up there yet. I don't know. And, uh...it just might tell thought that I didn't belong to ASCAP. Oh, yeah. That's right too.
